name: simple-coordinate
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: datsuns
description: the simplest plugin to display corrdinates

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Draws the player's coordinates 'X:%4.1f Y:%4.1f Z:%4.1f' in white at the top left (gui 5,5, no shadow); hidden by default, the comma key (HID 54, its default) toggles it. Direction and angle can be added in its settings.
note: Not yet: Its settings screen (Cloth Config through Mod Menu: position, colour, direction, angle) isn't checked.
